method: CUA native accessibility observations and displayed screenshots on the actual deployed Tauri client, combined with retained HTTP/SQL receipts

checks.name: codex_attachment_result
checks.observation: Actual native UI showed the attached private file, exact generated marker, saved-file artifact and selected ChatGPT subscription identity.

checks.name: computer_decoded_desktop
checks.observation: Opening the full Computer viewer after restart acquired a fresh ticket and visibly decoded the private Linux desktop.

checks.name: human_takeover_and_handback
checks.observation: Take control showed a remote keyboard and You have control; server lease holder became human. Return control restored view-only presentation; holder became none and the former interactive viewer returned 401.

checks.name: routine_survives_client_quit
checks.observation: Actual Cmd-Q closed the native gateway. Read-only server evidence shows a new Codex Routine admitted and settled successfully before relaunch.

checks.name: relaunch_retains_scope_draft_and_result
checks.observation: Relaunch restored Ngertiin Demo / NMA-083 codex, the exact unsent draft and NMA083-RESPONSIBILITY-SURVIVED. The synthetic draft was cleared after verification.

checks.name: muse_native_result
checks.observation: Switching to NMA-083 muse showed the exact current attachment marker, saved file, completed Computer activity and the selected Muse API-key billing identity.

limitation: A preview retaining a pre-restart ticket displayed a re-attach error. Opening the full Computer viewer obtained a fresh working ticket. No automatic hidden-window preview recovery claim is made.
